The '''Attack on Duma's forces''' was a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that took place in [[3639 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Duma]] attempted to rally the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to ambush the Empire's top [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a preemptive strike by the [[Empire's Fury]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
== The battle ==
The Imperial Empire's Fury squadron surprised captain Duma and his fleet as it was preparing its own ambush in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], entering the system almost on top of a trio of [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], damaging them heavily. The Imperial fighter squadron weaved through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the system, defeating [[Starfighter|starfighters]] that were sent to intercept it and eventually destroying the bridge of Duma's flagship, a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]], killing the Republic captain. By the end of the battle, the majority of Republic forces were crippled, with at least four Thranta corvettes being confirmed destroyed entirely.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duma Strike is an Imperial Heroic space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The system in which the battle takes place is never specified but the games galaxy map places the encounter in the northern part of the galaxy, northeast of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and possibly in around grid square M-3.<ref name="SWTOR" />
